list.text: It's fun to see how the grass and the ground have a different color because of the volcanic ash.
Can you explain to me why it's so cool here?
The volcano's ash blocks some of the sunlight.
Route 113\nEast to Route 111.
Do you know you're walking amidst volcanic ash?
When I see a Trainer full of energy, I can't just stand there and watch.
We have to battle!
It doesn't matter if you're good or bad at singing, or with Pokémon.
If you have a lot of fun, you win!
D-Do you want to battle me?\nI just caught my Pokémon.
Ah, so now you want to say a word to the loser?

You're really good at this, I'm impressed.
